mas-optimiser documentation / Experiment planner

Experiment planner

What an experiment of the improvement loop can show, and what it costs, for a design of your choosing. Every figure is worked out from the formulas of the page Sizing an experiment; nothing here runs anything. Figures marked measured come from stored runs, and those marked assumed are placeholders to replace with your own. Each setting is explained in full on Experiment settings, and those this page has no control for are listed at its foot.

The smallest gain the gate finds, against the validation tasks

The true gain that the gate keeps with the chosen power at the first decision of an experiment. The dot is this design. Theory, not data: it supposes the spread of a task's difference given under "The model", divided by the square root of the attempts at each task.

The settings this page has no control for

  
An experiment file has 29 settings. Six are controls above; the rest name things, switch things on or off, or set limits, and have no number to plot. They are listed here so that every setting can be seen in one place. Each name leads to its section of Experiment settings.
